versions.content: If UdpNmGlobalPnSupport is set to TRUE , a NM-PDU has been transmitted on a NM-Channel and UdpNm_TxConfirmation is called with result E_OK for this NM-PDU, then the UdpNm module shall forward the confirmation to Nm by calling Nm_PncBitVectorTxConfirmation with the stored PNC bit vector (see [SWS_UdpNm_00500]) for this NM-channel with result set to E_OK .
